limitations: Small public-control reconstructions only; no full site copy, page scripts, CSS/media, authenticated state or actual extension execution.
Layout-box visibility, readonly focus and center hit tests do not prove a complete keyboard traversal or assistive-technology experience.
Inline handler presence is represented with inert return-false attributes; script URL strings are preserved but handler implementations are not copied.

On the library page, Playwright object-argument evaluation serialization failed (refs.set is not a function); the same read-only DOM reconstruction succeeded with a primitive JSON string argument and array bookkeeping. No security/certificate settings or page behavior was altered.

annotationValidation.method: Offline fixture DOM and ariaSnapshot comparison against independently observed live-source metadata; product detector/ranker/evaluator not imported or run.
